tex_content.html:
Lemma
[linearity of the bracket]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-2

1. ch0:5.3For smooth vector fields $X,Y,Z$ and scalars $a,b\in \mathbb {R}$ one has $[aX+bY,Z]=a[X,Z]+b[Y,Z]$.
Proof

\sketch

Apply additivity of the bracket in its first slot to the sum $aX+bY$, then pull out the constants $a$ and $b$ by homogeneity in the first slot. Both facts follow from the local commutator expression of section 4.

□
